description: Clock, date, five upcoming alarms, custom MP3 and hourly RGB effects.

names.show_test_button: Show Light, RGB and Sound buttons
names.hourly_led_enabled: Light the RGB strip every hour
names.show_alarm_list: Show next five alarms on the left
names.led_all_hours: Hourly light all day and night
names.use_audio_service: Play custom MP3 through local service

descriptions.color: HEX RRGGBB or #RRGGBB; also cyan, white, green, amber, red, blue, purple, pink.
descriptions.font_size: 24–240 px; text shrinks automatically in small widgets.
descriptions.date_color: HEX or an English color name, as for time.
descriptions.countdown_color: HEX or an English color name, as for time.
descriptions.sound_verified: Only hides the warning; does not enable missing firmware audio.
descriptions.gong_end: 8–22: last chime at 21:00. Equal start/end means all day; overnight windows work.
descriptions.alarms: Time: 7:00. Rules use English: Mon-Fri; Mon,Tue,Sat; daily; off; once 2026-12-24; monthly 15; yearly 24.12; days 2 2026-11-01; hours 6 2026-11-01; minutes 30 2026-11-01; Mon,Wed weeks 2 2026-11-02. MP3 needs rolid-audio.
descriptions.use_audio_service: Requires installing rolid-audio once over SSH. The service listens only inside the Deck.

language_description: Changes the display; the installed .nar variant determines the form language.
